items.title: Rudolph Beaulieu Interview, 1961-05-31
items.q: See like Piron? Yeah. Oh, Piron had a band mostly string instruments.

ctx.x: else. When you say a string band, what would be the usual instruments in a string band?

Why they call it a string band? That drum, piano, guitar and bass. So this, that trumpet and trombone was the only two, you know what I mean, in sight. The rest was all string instruments. So they used to call it a string band. And violin? Yeah, they used to use violin too. See like Piron? Yeah. Oh, Piron had a band mostly string instruments. He used to use violinists. Then they had guitar, he had piano and bass. That's a lot of string instruments in a band. Yeah, that's right. And with drums, you know. And with…
More like a string instrument. Yeah.
